draw: Two bags. Every boss appears before any repeats; the order differs each cycle.
rule: Bosses are deliberately different SHAPES, not bigger numbers. Each carries a note that prints when it rises.
uniques: Rare modified versions of the EIGHT lords - never new lords. Each keeps its lord's shape and twists it: a different behaviour, with its stats skewed to match (lower hp for a faster one, and so on), never just a bigger number. 'shape' names the modifier and what it does.

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Thrice-Kindled
lesser_uniques.shape: its cold fire clings - the ground it crosses stays burning behind it

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Guttered
lesser_uniques.shape: its fire burnt low - quicker and desperate, it strikes twice and fades fast

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Overfull
lesser_uniques.shape: no bigger than the base wall, but she never stops spilling brood - it keeps replacing itself

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Split
lesser_uniques.shape: cut in two and still coming - each half a smaller wall that births its own

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Unburdened
lesser_uniques.shape: sheds its dead early and often - a thinning crowd that will not thin

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, the Famished
lesser_uniques.shape: faster and frailer - it swoops twice before you hear the first

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Roosted
lesser_uniques.shape: slower, heavier, and it never comes alone - the dark around it is all wings

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Marshalled
lesser_uniques.shape: it keeps its dead close - fewer drop, but those that stand hold a line

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Ashbound
lesser_uniques.shape: no clinging fire, just a cold that never lifts - slower and relentless

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Hollowed
lesser_uniques.shape: her brood gone and nothing left to spill - a wall that only holds, and holds

lesser_uniques.name: The Grubmother, Starved
lesser_uniques.shape: thin for a wall and far too quick - what little brood she has comes hungry

lesser_uniques.name: The Rattling Host, Silent
lesser_uniques.shape: no rattle at all - the crowd is on you before the floor says so

lesser_uniques.name: Nightwing, Broken-Winged
lesser_uniques.shape: grounded and furious - it cannot swoop, so it will not let go

lesser_uniques.name: The Hollow King, Unmade
lesser_uniques.shape: it comes apart as it fights, and every piece of it is still burning

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Half-Woken
greater_uniques.shape: only half risen - slower and softer in the body, but its breath comes deep and ill-tempered

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Unending
greater_uniques.shape: it raises its bones faster than any party can lay them down

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Stripped
greater_uniques.shape: its ward broken - lighter and quicker, and it swings for the throat now

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Unmasked
greater_uniques.shape: no patience left - she opens throats on the first pass and does not curtsy

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, the Deep Freeze
greater_uniques.shape: frost in sheets and the whole floor going to ice - everything slows but it

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Wakeful
greater_uniques.shape: fully roused - no slower, but the breath comes with no warning at all

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, Gracious
greater_uniques.shape: all courtesy - she lets you come to her, slower, then opens the throat

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Thawing
greater_uniques.shape: its frost failing - softer and faster, lashing out as the ice cracks

greater_uniques.name: The Gravewyrm, Coiled
greater_uniques.shape: it never leaves its ring - everything must come to the breath instead

greater_uniques.name: The Ossuary Lord, Kneeling
greater_uniques.shape: it spends its own ward to raise two at a time - unguarded, and never alone

greater_uniques.name: The Pale Duchess, in Mourning
greater_uniques.shape: veiled and slow, and every blow she lands grieves whoever stands nearest

greater_uniques.name: Mourncoil, Unspooled
greater_uniques.shape: its coils apart and striking from three sides of the room, each one thinner
